published.source: Scorpid Sting duty preset (standards 23), 2026-10-15: 180 s, 20000 iterations, seed 1

verify.note: same sim as the published number

summary: Melee Survival 7/10/34 on a one-hand axe and a dagger with a cat: Predator's Edge, Expose Prey into Mongoose Bite, Strider Kick and Lacerating Strikes. It ships as Forever's melee hunter build; a ranged Survival build plays like Marksmanship and is only documented. On Scorpid Sting duty it takes Improved Stings 3 for 3 points of Careful Aim, so the sting lasts 65 s and it steps out of melee for it three times in 3 minutes.
rotation: Pre-pull: walk into melee at -6 s, Aspect of the Beast at -3 s
Racials, potions and other cooldowns on cooldown

Scorpid Sting (2% off the boss's hit, 9% of base mana, 65 s with Improved Stings 3) at the pull and again in its last 3 s, stepping out of melee to the sim's 12 yd ranged minimum for it and back in once it is on its way; the raid's Scorpid Sting is off
Mongoose Bite whenever Expose Prey (or a dodge) opens it
Raptor Strike queued on the next swing when ready
Wing Clip in free GCDs (mana >= 50%), held when Mongoose Bite or Strider Kick is about ready
consumes: Dense Sharpening Stone (main hand and off hand)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 32 Agility and 14 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Pet scaling: 10% of RAP plus hunter hit (SoD placeholder for hit); on SoD's full 22% pet scaling this build would gain +18 (2026-10-12 gear)
Wildstalker Armor 4P/5P not in the preset (2P only); with them this build would gain 0 (measured on the 2026-10-12 gear)
Raptor Strike rank 8 adds 96, halfway from the client's 70 to Era's 0.88 (assumption hunter_raptor_31plus, user ruling 2026-10-15); the ranks below keep the client's values
Orc is best through Axe Specialization on its main hand axe, 11 ahead of the Night Elf
Fire-toasted Bun (+9) left out as a seasonal item; Elemental Sharpening Stone left out (MC-only plans)
22% more crit per Agility than Classic (assumption hunter_crit_per_agi, user ruling 2026-10-15: the beta's level 1 ratio carried to 60)

A pet's hit scales with its attack speed as in Classic (assumption hunter_pet_speed, user ruling 2026-10-15; on the beta every pet hits like a 2.0 sec pet); the cat is still the best pet and every cat speed sims within 1 DPS
Keeps Rhok'delar's 2.9 sec bow: Survival never shoots, so every ranged candidate of standards 22 sims the same

Scorpid Sting duty (standards 23): the request switches the raid's Scorpid Sting off and the hunter keeps its own up; it costs 61.6 / 52.2 / 45.1 DPS at 120 / 180 / 300 s against hunter__survival, most of it the trips out of melee and the 3 points of Careful Aim (22 of it at 180 s)
The sting only lowers the boss's hit (2%, the slot it shares with Insect Swarm, whose raid debuff stays on), so it adds nothing to the raid's damage
notes: Request is hunter__survival's with the rotation swapped for ui/hunter/apls/sv_scorpid.apl.json (tools/rotopt/hunter_presets.sh) and the Improved Stings talents and debuffs.scorpidSting removed; mksettings writes the same raid as spec hunter_sv_scorpid. Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_sv) unchanged; it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions. Distance is 5 yd as in the mksettings raid the number was measured in (the UI preset starts at 25 yd; the APL walks in 6 s before the pull, which the preset says costs nothing). Survival keeps a 1.0 sec cat out (DefaultOptions).
